title: Agent Context Engineering
problem: How context is built, edited and retained across long-horizon agent tasks.
method: An industry survey spanning context editing, agent design, inference, model architecture and infrastructure.
output: An original research deck, published in the Insights library.

title: VGGT Workload Analysis
problem: Where multimodal and 3D reconstruction models spend compute and memory.
method: Workload characterisation across model stages and architecture choices.
output: Planned workload breakdown for the World Models research track.

title: AI Infrastructure Taxonomy
problem: How to classify compute, memory, networking, storage and power bottlenecks consistently.
method: A workload-grounded taxonomy of training and inference systems.

title: World Models & 3D Reconstruction
problem: How spatial reconstruction connects to grounding for language and action agents.

title: AI Investment Research Framework
problem: How technical bottlenecks connect to public-market valuation assumptions.
method: Connect compute, power, networking and software analysis with valuation discipline.

title: Olfactory AI Research
problem: Whether learning approaches to smell generalise across tasks and datasets.
method: Literature review of representations and data constraints.
